module autovcoder_022880 (
    input i_clk,
    output wire o_uart_tx
);

  wire clk;
  wire locked;

  //Create a 16MHz clock from 12MHz using PLL
  SB_PLL40_PAD #(
      .FEEDBACK_PATH("SIMPLE"),
      .DIVR(4'b0000),
      .DIVF(7'b1010100),
      .DIVQ(3'b110),
      .FILTER_RANGE(3'b001)
  ) pll (
      .LOCK(locked),
      .RESETB(1'b1),
      .BYPASS(1'b0),
      .PACKAGEPIN(i_clk),
      .PLLOUTCORE(clk)
  );

  reg rst = 1'b1;

  always @(posedge clk) rst <= !locked;

  parameter memfile_emitter = "emitter.hex";

  wire [7:0] tdata;
  wire       tlast;
  wire       tvalid;
  wire       tready;

  corescorecore corescorecore (
      .i_clk   (clk),
      .i_rst   (rst),
      .o_tdata (tdata),
      .o_tlast (tlast),
      .o_tvalid(tvalid),
      .i_tready(tready)
  );

  emitter #(
      .memfile(memfile_emitter)
  ) emitter (
      .i_clk    (clk),
      .i_rst    (rst),
      .i_tdata  (tdata),
      .i_tlast  (tlast),
      .i_tvalid (tvalid),
      .o_tready (tready),
      .o_uart_tx(o_uart_tx)
  );

endmodule
